messages:
izzy: Running into a reproducible hang when cancelling streaming completions in the python SDK (v0.24.1) using SSE/chunked mode + uvloop. Minimal repro below.

izzy: repro: 
```py
# py3.11 + uvloop
async def reader(client):
    stream = await client.stream('completion', model='open-llm')
    try:
        async for piece in stream:
            do_stuff(piece)
    finally:
        # often never reached if task.cancel() races with incoming chunk
        await stream.aclose()

# test
t = asyncio.create_task(reader(client))
await asyncio.sleep(0.02)
t.cancel()
await asyncio.sleep(0.2)  # sometimes loop spins, socket stays ESTABLISHED
```

anita: I can repro locally. When it hangs one core spins and socket remains ESTABLISHED.

maria: Two notes: (1) Our typing currently exposes AsyncIterator[bytes] which doesn't require aclose(). We should either return an AsyncGenerator or document .aclose() explicitly. (2) We should provide `async with client.stream(...) as s:` so finalization is automatic.

izzy: Agreed. Also noticed websocket mode doesn't hit this, only SSE/chunked.

tyler: Created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3682 and internal ticket SDK-9123. Assigning to eng oncall for triage.

ops-bot: Ticket SDK-9123 created (labels: bug, py-sdk, streaming).

anita: Quick workaround for folks hitting this in the wild: catch CancelledError and call aclose in the except/finally: 
```py
stream = await client.stream(...)
try:
    async for c in stream:
        ...
except asyncio.CancelledError:
    if hasattr(stream, 'aclose'):
        await stream.aclose()
    raise
finally:
    if hasattr(stream, 'aclose'):
        await stream.aclose()
```
Not pretty but cuts the leaks.

maria: Action items: (1) implement AsyncContextManager wrapper so users can `async with` the stream, (2) ensure stream object implements `.aclose()` and update typing to reflect AsyncGenerator/AsyncIteratorWithClose, (3) add a flaky test that cancels during chunk boundaries under uvloop and run in CI.

tyler: I'll pick up the context manager + typing change and add the regression test. Targeting v0.24.2 patch. Will also push a doc note to sample-apps to avoid naive `async for` until fixed.

izzy: Thanks — will verify patch on my repro. :thumbsup:
